articles.title: Bird flu confirmed in Tamil Nadus Cuddalore; 90-day breeding ban and rapid culling under way, says district collector

articles.title: Bird flu confirmed in Tamil Nadus Cuddalore; 90-day breeding ban and rapid culling under way, says district collector
articles.sentence: CUDDALORE: The national laboratory in Bhopal, which tested tissue and blood samples collected from dead chickens on poultry farms in Cuddalore district, has confirmed an outbreak of avian influenza (bird flu) in the district.
articles.context: CUDDALORE: The national laboratory in Bhopal, which tested tissue and blood samples collected from dead chickens on poultry farms in Cuddalore district, has confirmed an outbreak of avian influenza (bird flu) in the district. The collector said the initial spike in poultry mortality was reported in Thimmanampettai in the Cuddalore-Kurinjipadi belt on Oct 30.Tissue samples sent to state and central laboratories confirmed bird flu-positive results from the Bhopal facility.
